title: Click Clusters II
vars: 10 hits over 0.8 s, 3 semitones down, bigger body. Servo at half.
7 hits over 0.9 s, 5 semitones down, more thump. Servo at a third.
5 hits over 1 s, 7 semitones down, thump up front. Servo faint, lower (160 → 900 Hz), longer.
8 hits over 1.1 s, almost no speeding up. 5 down. Servo quiet and short.
Like b, but the servo is barely there: you hear its reverb more than the servo itself.
